artifacts.summary: Four-state fixture (a,b,c,d) on which the literal falsifier check is REFUTED for the landed shape stab(Fp -> stab Fp) and the mixed/past shapes stab(Fp -> stab Pp), stab P(stab Fp), while stab F(stab Fp) and stab(Pp -> stab Fp) survive non-vacuously; refutation core compiled standalone at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; value tables mechanically confirmed; proof template, toolchain pitfalls, wiring and phase sketch for the plan.

next_steps: Plan: one probe file specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/stab-depth-two-shared-stratum.lean on Fixture D (five depth-2 shapes, direct and through strata, shared-stratum certificates, positive and refutation theorems), append-only wiring into scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh, gate green.

memory_candidates.content: On ofSlicedStep fixtures with a custom finite enum carrier: hand-build Fintype (deriving Fintype fails), close successor/predecessor tables by decide, use Int.leInduction (Int.le_induction deprecated), factor constructed-history state functions into a def and discharge the step by unfold; split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega, and never put by omega inside an anonymous-constructor tuple (use lt_add_one / sub_one_lt).

A depth-2 stab-value is a function of the state (stab_state_only) but NOT of the depth-1 stab Fp bit: on the 4-state fixture a->a,a->b,b->b,b->d,d->b,c->c with p at b, stab(Fp -> stab Fp) differs on a,c and stab(Fp -> stab Pp), stab P(stab Fp) differ on b,d, all sharing the stab Fp value. Per-state labels must cover every stab-subformula of the atomized target, including backward ones.
